python -c "
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/portfolio/pygments-src')
from pygments import highlight
from pygments.lexers import PythonLexer, SqlLexer, HtmlLexer, JavascriptLexer
from pygments.formatters import HtmlFormatter
mix = [(open(p, encoding='utf-8').read(), L) for p, L in [('bigfile.py', PythonLexer), ('query.sql', SqlLexer), ('sample.html', HtmlLexer), ('sample.js', JavascriptLexer)]]
for src, lexer in mix: highlight(src, lexer(), HtmlFormatter())
"
